About Revvity:

At Revvity, we're leaders in the human diagnostics and life sciences industry, delivering cutting-edge lab instruments, reagents, and top-level scientific software. We're now embarking on an exciting journey to harness the power of AI across our entire organization. We envision a future where AI enhances creativity, boosts productivity, and unlocks new potential in every aspect of our business. Our dedicated team is pioneering the integration of AI-driven technologies to help our employees work smarter, faster, and more innovatively. We're committed to responsible AI development that improves business outcomes while upholding our core values. If you're seeking a meaningful, impactful, and stimulating internship in enterprise AI application, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

About you:

You're passionate about artificial intelligence, with a particular interest in how generative AI and large language models (LLMs) can transform business operations. You embody our core values:



- Embrace the unknown: You start each day with a "What if?" mindset, ready to explore how AI can revolutionize traditional business processes.
- Partner with purpose: You're excited to work alongside diverse teams, using AI to accelerate positive outcomes across all departments.
- Passion for people: You understand that AI's true potential lies in augmenting human capabilities, not replacing them.
- Collaborate for success: You thrive in team environments, putting collective goals before individual recognition, and valuing transparency and integrity in your work.


You're a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity, and excited by the prospect of applying cutting-edge AI technologies to real-world business challenges.

What you'll do:

Within 30 days



- Complete onboarding, gaining familiarity with our enterprise systems and ongoing AI initiatives
- Provide feedback on your onboarding experience, embodying our value of continuous improvement
- Build relationships across various departments to understand their unique challenges and AI opportunities
- Gain a basic understanding of our business operations and how AI can enhance productivity


Beyond 60 days



- Develop prototypes and proofs-of-concept for AI-powered features that can boost employee productivity and creativity
- Contribute to the development of prompt engineering strategies for various business applications
- Participate in creating AI-driven tools that can be integrated into our existing workflow systems
- Collaborate on AI model integration projects, ensuring seamless user experiences across different platforms
- Assist in evaluating and benchmarking AI performance against business KPIs and user satisfaction metrics
- Present your work and findings to stakeholders, translating complex AI concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences
fit_why: Full-stack AI prototyping matches his RAG, React, Node and OpenAI experience

role: Intern-Procurement (Supply Chain Automation): Agentic AI Content Design Intern
jd:
Tallgrass is hiring an Agentic AI Content Design Intern within Procurement’s Supply Chain Automation group. The intern will help design and test AI agents and workflows and create clear, standardized visual communications for Procurement and Supply Chain teams.

Responsibilities



- Help define and document AI agent personas for communication work—such as a Presentation Designer, Booklet Editor, Brand and Style Reviewer, and Data-to-Visual Storyteller—including each persona's purpose, tone, audience, and expected outputs
- Draft, test, and refine prompts, agent instructions, and reusable skills that guide AI agents toward consistent, high-quality results
- Help assemble multi-step agentic workflows that take a request from initial brief to outline, first draft, review, revision, and final deliverable, with human review at key checkpoints
- Test agent outputs for accuracy, clarity, brand alignment, and audience fit; log issues and suggest improvements
- Use AI agents together with PowerPoint and design tools to help create presentations, booklets, one-pagers, infographics, and process visuals for Procurement and Supply Chain teams
- Translate procurement data, processes, and policies into clear, easy-to-follow charts, diagrams, and narratives
- Help build a standardized library of graphical resources—templates, slide layouts, icons, chart styles, and style guidance—aligned with Tallgrass brand standards
- Review draft presentations and documents and offer constructive input on structure, storytelling, clarity, and visual hierarchy
- Help create practical communication aids such as checklists, tip sheets, and before-and-after examples, and support a lunch-and-learn or demo session for the team
- Document agents, workflows, and lessons learned in a shared playbook so the work continues after the internship
- Follow Company guidelines for responsible AI use, including using approved tools only and protecting confidential, supplier, and personal information
- Present an end-of-internship capstone to Procurement and Supply Chain Automation leadership summarizing what you built, what you learned, and recommendations for next steps
fit_why: Content design and PowerPoint/visual work, not software engineering; some AI overlap

About Firework
Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact

Firework is redefining the future of commerce as an AI and video commerce company — combining cutting-edge technology, an exclusive network of enterprise brands and retailers, and a first-mover position to win the agentic commerce race.

We've built the world's most advanced and largest video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. But we're more than software — our compounding network effect grows stronger with every partner we add, bringing the energy of in-store experiences online and transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships at scale.

Having raised over $235M to date, led by investors such as SoftBank Vision Fund 2, and operating at global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to solve complex challenges and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected commerce.

If you're curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas — Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape what comes next. Together.

Summary
We are seeking a motivated and curious Data Engineer Intern to join our engineering team and gain hands-on experience building and maintaining data infrastructure. In this role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to support the development of data pipelines, data processing systems, and analytics tools that power business intelligence, product development, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in programming and data concepts, enjoys solving technical challenges, and is eager to learn about modern data engineering technologies and best practices.

This internship offers an opportunity to work on meaningful projects, gain exposure to real-world data systems, and develop technical skills in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

What You'll Be Doing


- Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and infrastructure that support analytics, business intelligence, and machine learning applications 
- Support the development of ETL/ELT processes to collect, transform, and organize data from various sources 
- Write and optimize SQL queries and Python scripts to support data processing, reporting, and analysis 
- Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, and analytics teams to improve data accessibility, quality, and reliability 
- Help build and maintain data tools and dashboards that provide actionable insights into business and product performance 
- Gain hands-on experience with cloud-based data infrastructure, data warehouses, and modern data processing technologies 
- Assist in troubleshooting data pipeline issues, identifying performance improvements, and implementing solutions with guidance from senior engineers 
- Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and team meetings while learning engineering best practices 
- Document data processes, workflows, and technical solutions to support ongoing development and knowledge sharing 


We'll be excited if you have


- Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field 
- Foundational knowledge of Python and SQL, including experience writing queries, manipulating data, or developing scripts through coursework, projects, or internships 
- Basic understanding of databases, data structures, and data processing concepts 
- Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, or data warehousing concepts 
- Interest in learning modern AI and data technologies such as Claude, Snowflake, BigQuery, Apache Spark, Flink, or Apache Airflow 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a willingness to learn 
- Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment 
- A proactive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and enthusiasm for working with data and emerging technologies 
- Previous technical projects, relevant coursework, or internship experience in data engineering, software development, or analytics is a plus, but not required 


Location
The role is on-site and we are looking for candidates in the Bay Area who can go to the San Mateo office.

Compensation
The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: The estimated pay range for this role is $20-$25 per hour.

The posted pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the compensation for this position and is subject to change based on business need. To determine a successful candidate’s starting pay, we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location, an evaluation of the candidate’s skills and experience, market demands, and internal parity. Candidates may receive more information from the talent partner.

Don’t hold back
We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past. As an equal employment opportunity employer, we are a diverse team that strives for an inclusive environment for all. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
fit_why: Data engineering internship matches his Python, SQL, pipeline and analytics background
